payload.blocks: Only closing plan 261124-1433-authority-declare-update (acceptance criteria 5 and 6). All four phases are on main at 03d5fd4a9; the DOCOS plan 261124-0837 can already use the new verb once a release carries it.
payload.headline: Run the full test gate and one release check for authority declare --update? My confined session cannot.

parts.cause: Unit and head sandboxes cannot write git metadata or ~/.local/state: npm test stops at the full-suite lock (EROFS), cargo test --workspace has 50 failures, 33 of them naming git-floor-probe-failed Read-only file system and 17 doctor/events tests unrelated to this plan. The release check needs a staged and activated release.

options.cost: About 30 minutes of machine time plus 10 minutes by hand.
options.does: From the main checkout: npm test; cargo test --workspace; then after activating a release from 03d5fd4a9 or later, the commands in the report section 'Pending owner action' of plans/261124-1433-authority-declare-update/reports/integration-261124-1612-authority-declare-update.md.
options.gain: The plan closes with real evidence for criteria 5 and 6, and any of the 17 unexplained Rust failures is seen outside the sandbox.
options.label: You run both checks

options.does: Mark the plan done now on the focused proofs and the land gates, and leave the full gate and the release check to the next release window.
options.harm: Criteria 5 and 6 stay unproven; a regression elsewhere could hide until the next full run.
options.label: Close on focused proofs

parts.recommendation: You run both checks: the 17 non-sandbox Rust failures need a clean run to tell real failures from sandbox noise, and criterion 5 is the user-visible fix.

scope.allows: Running the test suites and the listed release check, and me recording the results in the plan and closing it.
scope.forbids: Any code change, any change to the shell helper or the model, and waiving a failing gate.

parts.what: All code and docs landed. Focused proofs pass: cargo test -p fgos-component-authority (67), cargo test -p fgos --test authority (6), selector check, render --check drift []. Two checks are still unrun: the full npm test plus cargo test --workspace, and the hand check that the installed host run from a linked worktree writes that worktree.
